summary: Token linkage fix built + PROVEN. Daemon: state.agents now persisted to BASE/agents.json (saveAgents on /agent/start, /agent/done, /overlay/status upsert; restored on boot) so transcript records survive restarts. taskTokens now resolves transcript via assignee agent's .session (dirname(mainTranscript)+session.jsonl) when transcript_path absent, in addition to direct transcript_path and the single-task-session fallback. subagent-start.sh now sends session_id to /agent/start (daemon already stored session/task/workspace). Restarted daemon. VERIFIED end-to-end: registered a transcript-bearing agent 'tok-demo', force-claimed task #12 with it -> /state showed tokens=2,536,711; restored assignee to main -> tokens null; cleaned up tok-demo (agents.json emptied + restart, agents count 0). CONVENTION REQUIRED for real numbers: subagents must claim via start_task using the SAME agent_id the SubagentStart hook registers the transcript under (the harness agent id) — only then does assignee join the transcript. Historical tasks cannot backfill (their agent records were never persisted). Going forward, live subagent work that claims with its harness id will show accurate per-task token cost (live, via 2s poll + 4s cache).
